Do you enjoy working accurately and do you have a valid Dutch work permit? Then this position is for you. For Arvato in Heijen, we are looking for motivated packing operators who ensure that products are correctly adjusted, packed and made ready for shipment. You will work in a dynamic logistics environment where teamwork, quality and safety are central. In addition, you have the chance of a contract upon good performance.

As a packing operator, you are responsible for carefully processing products before they are shipped. Your tasks include:

    - Depalletizing boxes, opening boxes and packaging
    
- Making space in packaging for documentation
    
- Adding a leaflet and manual to products
    
- Labeling and scanning boxes, plus stacking boxes on pallets

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary contract via Manpower with the chance of direct employment upon good performance
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Travel allowance according to the employer’s policy
    
- Working in a modern and well-organized logistics environment
    
- Shift allowance (when working in shifts)

    - Able to work accurately with attention to detail
    
- Able to provide a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a valid Dutch work permit
    
- Flexible regarding working hours (shift work) and overtime
    
- Good command of the English language
    
- Good physical condition and no physical complaints, due to the nature of the work

Do you want to work in a modern logistics environment where teamwork and quality are central? Apply today via Manpower and we will contact you as soon as possible to discuss the possibilities. You might soon start as a Packing Operator! 📦🚀

- Operating an EPT to move goods safely
    
- Contributing to a clean and well-organized work environment

- Pension accrual via Manpower

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 19,49 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.

You are at least 16 years old

Looking for a stable full-time job in logistics within a clean, modern, and high-tech working environment? Join a growing international company where you'll work with great colleagues and contribute to the logistics process behind some of the world's leading technology companies.
As a Logistics Employee, you are responsible for ensuring a smooth flow of materials throughout the production process. You make sure materials are delivered to the right place at the right time, preventing delays and disruptions.

Your responsibilities include:

- Transporting materials to and from the production floor.
- Ensuring a smooth and efficient material flow throughout the warehouse and production areas.
- Operating an EPT, stacker, (and forklift) safely and efficiently.
- Identifying and resolving logistical issues, escalating them to your supervisor when necessary.
- Supporting inventory management by performing stock counts and inventory checks.
- Following safety procedures and maintaining an organized workplace.
- Working closely with colleagues to ensure daily operational targets are achieved.

- Some experience in logistics or warehouse operations
- Valid EPT, stacker, and forklift certificates with practical experience
- Good command of the English language (minimum B1; B2 is preferred)
- Able to work independently while also being a strong team player
- Accurate, flexible, and proactive
- Available for a full-time position in a two-shift schedule

Get an awesome salary of €16,78 and enjoy working dayshifts only! All while working with the best smelling flowers. Read on and watch your new job as an orderpicker blossom, literally. 🌸 Apply today at Royal FloraHolland in Honselersdijk! 🥳

What we offer
- € 16,60 bruto per hour
- Opportunity for a permanent contract!
- Travel allowance or public transport subscription
- Participation in staff association & fun events!
- Get €0,18 extra allowance. You'll get €16,78 p/h💸
- Enjoy free flowers up to 5 times a year! 💐

Who you are
To make sure everything runs smoothly, it's important that as an orderpicker, you'll meet the following requirements:

- You are available at least 3 days a week, especially on Mondays.
- You can start working at 05:45h and the ending time is between 09:30h and 12:00h.
- You have your own place to stay in The Netherlands.
- You are available at least till October.
- You speak Dutch or English.

What will you do
Every day, so many flowers leave Royal FloraHolland to be delivered to shops and florists across the country. 🌼 And they have to arrive fresh and flawless. Before the stores even open! That’s where you, as an orderpicker, come in.

Early in the morning, you’ll be working with carts full of beautiful flowers. You check if everything is correct: Are the flowers fresh and in good condition? Does the cart match the order?
Once everything is perfect, you roll the cart to the right spot. Then, a small electric vehicle (kind of like a mini lawn mower!) picks it up and brings it straight to the truck. Thanks to your work, the flowers arrive on time and in top shape at their destination! 🙌

Where will you work
You’ll be working at the world’s largest flower auction site! Yes, really! That’s how massive the warehouse in Honselersdijk (near Naaldwijk) is. As an orderpicker, you will find  your way around in no time though. Within weeks  you’ll be driving like a pro

What will you do
If you start working as a production employee at Kuehne Nagel, you will have a varied job. You will process the returns from Albert Heijn. One moment you are busy with the packaging of empty crates and bottles and you make sure that they are sorted and placed in the right place. The next moment you as a production employee are processing the returned food (that could no longer be sold). You make sure that the products are neatly separated. Another moment you may help unload the trucks with the products. Then you take them to the right place in the warehouse. Your work is very diverse!

Where will you work
Kuehne Nagel in Utrecht has three locations. You will work as a production employee in the distribution center in Maarssen. This is where all returned products from Albert Heijn that can no longer be sold end up. You will work in an international team with enthusiastic colleagues. There is an informal working atmosphere.
